Hi Julian,

Thanks for coming back to us, and option 1 is noted: the $200 goes on your account as store credit.

I have passed it to the team to apply, and a colleague is picking it up today and will confirm it with you. Once it is on your account, it sits there and comes off automatically at checkout on any future order, with no expiry.

Nothing else on order Shop···· changes. Your Harlo H15 Dual, the Power Kit and the Harlo OS Diagnostics plan all stay on the order, and it ships by November 30, 2026. Sorry again for the extra wait on that.

If you would rather put the $200 toward something now instead, just say the word and I can go through what we have in stock.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
